presentation.label: MACKITY
presentation.summary: Chris Johnson's Airwindows Mackity: the input stage of a Mackie-style mixing desk, driven by IN TRIM, on FX1 or FX2 of any track.
presentation.overview: Mackity is Airwindows' model of a Mackie-style desk's input stage. The track's audio passes a gentle low cut, the desk's high-frequency rolloff, the IN TRIM gain and the console's clip, rounded by its curve, then a second rolloff and a DC blocker. At TRIM 13 it adds only the desk's colour; turning TRIM up drives the channel into the clip, from warm thickening to hard, square distortion. PAD sets the output level. The algorithm is upstream's, unchanged, in 24-bit fixed point at the Octatrack's 44.1 kHz.
highlights: Upstream's complete Mackity algorithm, credited to Chris Johnson
TRIM from silence through 0 dB (13) to +39.6 dB into the console's clip
Stereo and buffer-free: FX1 or FX2 on any track
usage: Put MACKITY on FX1 of a drum or bass track. At TRIM 13 and PAD 127 it adds the desk's colour without a change in level.
Turn TRIM up for drive: at 26 (+12 dB) a track peaking at -12 dBFS reaches the clip, and above that it clips harder.
Turn PAD down to set the output level after heavy drive.

controls.name: TRIM
controls.doc: In Trim: the gain into the desk, (TRIM/13)^2 as in the original. 13 is 0 dB, 26 is +12 dB, 52 is +24 dB, 127 is +39.6 dB; 0 is silence. More gain drives the signal into the console's clip.

controls.name: PAD
controls.doc: Out Pad: the output level, PAD/128; 127 is exactly 0 dB, 64 is -6 dB, 0 is silence. With heavy drive the desk's rolloff peaks up to about 0.6 dB over full scale, which the Octatrack's output limits; PAD 120 or lower keeps every peak.

limitations: Not yet tested on a unit: the DSP code is checked bit for bit in the DSP emulator only.
At high TRIM the clip makes harmonics above 22 kHz that fold back below it, as the original does at 44.1 kHz.
With heavy drive, peaks up to about 0.6 dB over full scale are limited by the Octatrack's output; PAD 120 or lower keeps them.
The original's 32-bit float dither is left out: the Octatrack's path is 24-bit fixed point.

storage.label: Storage
storage.conditions: No buffer: 32 words of the track's own X state block per instance. Not measured as a package on a unit yet.

processing.label: CPU / DSP load
processing.conditions: dsp_host's meter reads 225.3 cycles a sample at every setting (TESTING.md); not measured on a unit yet.

tests.summary: verify.py renders the assembled module in dsp_host and matches the bit-exact model in every case it runs; test_reference.py holds that model to the original within 0.001 dB in level and -100 dB in residual. Not tested on a unit.
gates: Worst-case cycles on a unit, on both DSP cores
Exact memory region and maximum-instance totals
Owner-reviewed real-hardware evidence with actual coverage and limitations

access.location: Any audio track's FX1 or FX2 SETUP; MACKITY in the chooser.
steps: Select an audio track that plays something.
Hold FUNC and press FX1 (or FX2), highlight MACKITY with UP/DOWN, and press YES to assign it.
Press FX1 (or FX2) and edit TRIM with knob A and PAD with knob B.
Set TRIM 13 and PAD 127 for the desk's colour at unchanged level, or select NONE to remove it.
